top_signals.title: DCG’s Fortitude acquires 12.5 MW Nebraska facility for net $4.7 million, expanding Zcash mining portfolio
top_signals.summary: Fortitude Mining completed the cash acquisition of a 12.5 MW mining facility for a net outlay of about $4.7 million after credits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
